text:
Diego Alvarez: Hi team  Diego here, starting today on embeddings infra. Two setup asks as I ramp: 
1) Please link billing account `billing-dev-sandbox` to project `redwood-diego-sandbox` so I can run small BigQuery + Cloud SQL experiments (expected <$20/mo). Need this for us-central1 and europe-west9.
2) Grant my user: `roles/bigquery.dataViewer`, `roles/cloudsql.client`, and `roles/compute.networkUser` on project. Also need `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` for service account `sa-diego@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com` to run CI jobs.
Extra: Our team discovered the project is inside a VPC Service Control perimeter for eu data. Legal asked to confirm whether any datasets will contain EU personal data before we link billing. Who should I loop in?

Marta Ivanova: welcome Diego! For billing link ping @billing-team but legal needs a brief data classification note if the project touches EU personal data. Can you confirm datasets?

Diego Alvarez: At the moment only synthetic and public prompt sets. No personal data. We'll stay compliant but want the network access to europe-west9 for latency testing.

Samir Gupta: @Marta I can help verify the VPC-SC boundary. If the project is inside the perimeter we need an explicit egress exception or to move datasets. Diego  please add the dataset IDs in the ops ticket.

Legal Team: Thanks for confirming Diego. Please include the statement "no EU personal data processed" in the ticket and copy legal@redwood.com. We may still require a brief review due to the perimeter.

Diego Alvarez: Added note: "no EU personal data processed; synthetic/public test data only" and CCed legal.

billing-bot: Billing link request BILL-1239 created for project `redwood-diego-sandbox`. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-1239

ops-bot: Ticket OPS-5099 created for IAM, VPC-SC check, and network roles. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-5099

iam-bot: To proceed I need the principal email. Diego, confirm it's `diego.alvarez@redwood.com` and whether you want roles applied to user or service account. Also note: Cloud SQL client requires network connection from authorized networks.

Diego Alvarez: Yes, `diego.alvarez@redwood.com`. Apply bigquery + cloudsql to my user and serviceAccountUser to `sa-diego@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. I'll open a Cloud SQL authorized network request if needed.

Samir Gupta: Checked VPC-SC: project is within eu perimeter which blocks BigQuery cross-region export by default. Since you said datasets are synthetic, legal okayed a perimeter exception for testing. I'll request an egress exception for exports to us-central1 for 48h.

sec-bot: Security note: Ensure the service account does not get owner/admin scopes. Short-lived SA tokens only. We'll audit the service account bindings after apply.

ops-bot: IAM roles applied at 1919000090: `roles/bigquery.dataViewer`, `roles/cloudsql.client`, `roles/compute.networkUser` to `diego.alvarez@redwood.com`. `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` granted to CI principal for `sa-diego`.

Marta Ivanova: Billing linked at 1919000102. Diego, please verify you see project under Billing and try a small bq query or a Cloud SQL connect (read-only).

Diego Alvarez: Confirmed billing visible. I can run a simple `bq query --nouse_legacy_sql 'SELECT 1'` and connect to Cloud SQL (read-only) through the private IP. Thanks! :rocket:

Samir Gupta: Egress exception approved for 48h, filed as VPC-EXC-78. Use it only for your test runs. Will revoke after 48h automatically.

Diego Alvarez: Great, verified BigQuery query succeeded across regions. Everything works for my onboarding tests. Thanks everyone!

ops-bot: Updated OPS-5099 with BILL-1239, VPC-EXC-78, and IAM bindings. Closing follow-ups once the perimeter exception auto-revokes."
